sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc-Lko:38899
Court No. - 15
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 5540 of 2025

Applicant :- Smt. Vimlesh Maurya And 4 Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Anil Kumar Maurya
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Anil Kumar Maurya, the learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Ashok Srivastava, the
learned A.G.A. for the State and Ms. Priyanshi Maurya, Advocate who has put in appearance on
behalf of the opposite party no.2 and filed her vakalatnama, which is taken on record.
Short counter affidavit filed by the learned counsel for opposite party No.2 is taken on record.

2.  By means of the instant application filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C./Section 528 BNSS, the applicants have sought quashing of the impugned charge sheet dated 15.09.2022, summoning order dated 17.06.2023 along with entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.8864 of 2023, arising out of Case Crime No.215 of 2022, under Sections 406, 420 I.P.C. Police Station Tanda, District Ambedkar Nagar, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ambedkar Nagar.

entities.text: I.P.C. Police Station Tanda, District Ambedkar Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the parties submit that the parties have settled their dispute amicably outside Smt. Vimlesh Maurya And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. ...

entities.text: Vimlesh Maurya And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: the Court and they have arrived at a compromise.
A copy of compromise deed has been placed on record as Annexure-4 to the application.
The parties have confirmed the terms of compromise.
4. Opposite party No.2 does not have any objection, if the impugned proceedings are quashed against the applicants.
5. I have considered the submissions of learned counsel for the parties.

6. Considering the fact that the dispute between the parties is personal in nature and ratio laid down by the Supreme Court in the cases of B. S. Joshi and others versus State of Haryana and another :(2003) 4 SCC 675, Nikhil Merchant versus C.B.I. and another : (2008) 9 SCC 677, Manoj Sharma versus State and others : (2008) 16 SCC 1, Gian Singh versus Station of Punjab: (2010) 15 SCC 118 and Narinder Singh and others versus State of Punjab and another: (2014) 6 SCC 466, it would be appropriate in the facts and circumstances of the case to quash the criminal proceedings as continuance of the criminal proceedings would be an exercise in futility.

sentences.text: 7. In view of the fact that the parties have settled their dispute outside the Court by way of compromise arrived at between the parties and law laid down by the Supreme Court of India, the present application is allowed and the impugned charge sheet dated 15.09.2022, summoning order dated 17.06.2023 along with entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.8864 of 2023, arising out of Case Crime No.215 of 2022, under Sections 406, 420 I.P.C. Police Station Tanda, District Ambedkar Nagar,

pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ambedkar Nagar are hereby quashed.
.
